In this video I’m going to train AI to learn how to make BattleBot Combat Robots fight autonomously and then build them in real life.
Yes they’re made out of vacuum cleaners – called Henry and Harry – because they already have faces which makes them the ideal platform for embodied AI.
I'm using Pygame, Gymnasium, Stable_Baselines3 and Pytorch to train the model.
The first thing we need to do though, is train an artificial neural network to learn how to make BattleBots fight each other autonomously.
Gymnasium doesn’t have any graphical environment, so we’re going to use the game I already wrote for that.
